items.title: Frank Tiberi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 30, 2022
items.q: I have many of the Lennie Tristano tunes

ctx.x: Things that you’ve written down and that you’ve worked out in your head and then you’ve written them down for other people to use.

They’re all on Finale, they’re all on BandBox, Band in a Box actually, and I have another program with better sounds. I have all — I have all of the soloists that have performed all the tunes that I have in there and also I have many of the Lennie Tristano tunes, I have about 20 or 25, and I write them all and I write them all in concert alto and tenor, where many teachers only give you a concert part and they say, “Go ahead and play jazz.”
